calculation_handling.description: The parking required for a heritage site is the lesser of the Chapter 200 requirement and the number of spaces that existed on July 20, 1993.
calculation_handling.gaps: Needs the as-built count of parking spaces on that date; the Chapter 200 requirement is a cross-reference, not a literal.

calculation_handling.description: Added or replaced gross floor area on a heritage site must provide parking in compliance with the By-law or be authorized by a minor variance.

200.20.10(1).explanation: A heritage site designated under the Ontario Heritage Act needs only the lesser of the Chapter 200 parking requirement and the number of parking spaces that existed on July 20, 1993.

200.20.10(2).explanation: If floor area is added to or replaced on a heritage site, parking must meet this By-law or be authorized by a Section 45 Planning Act minor variance.
